name: claude-mail-mcp-shared
description: Not an installed package — neither manifest depends on this and neither lockfile mentions it. It exists for one line: "type": "module". Under module/moduleResolution NodeNext, TypeScript decides a file's module format from the nearest package.json, and the OAuth image compiles shared/ from a directory that has none above it (WORKDIR /app/oauth, shared/ at /app/shared). Without this marker these files emit as CommonJS in that image while emitting as ESM everywhere else, and the container dies at startup on a named import the compiler was perfectly happy with. See #126.
